stage: J: journal version of RAFT -- comparisons with competing objectives and gradient combiners, sensitivity, representation analysis, Electricity, and the GPT-2 forecaster
src_note: src/ is unchanged from Stage X (tag x-declared). All new code is in journal/ (raft_j.py, run_j.py, test_j.py).
forecaster: configs/frozen_forecaster.json: F (flatten head, no LLM) with the unchanged training configuration; part 'llm' uses the declared confirmation model E (GPT-2, flatten head, LLM policy norms_pos) with the same training configuration.

arms.none, tfb_a<x>, raft_a<x>, raft_rt_a<x>,: exactly the Stage X code paths
arms.rnc_cf_a<x>: Rank-N-Contrast (Zha et al., NeurIPS 2023) on the TD representation, ranked by the distance between the normalised futures (in place of L_RT), RAFT FD branch, conflict-free update; same similarity (cosine / tau, tau = 0.1) and the same instance cap (512) as RAFT
arms.rnctf_cf_a<x>: RnC in place of L_RT, plus RAFT's L_TF, conflict-free update
arms.raft_pc_a1: RAFT losses (L_RT + L_TF), combined with the forecasting gradient by PCGrad (Yu et al., NeurIPS 2020)
arms.raft_gs_a1: RAFT losses, gradient-similarity gating (Du et al., 2018): g_aux used only when cos(g_task, g_aux) > 0
arms.raft_cf_a1_tau<t>: RAFT with temperature t in both relational losses (default 0.1)
arms.e_<arm>: the same arm on the GPT-2 forecaster E

ECL.note: look-back 96 is the standard setting of the iTransformer / TimesNet benchmark; every 4th training window is used because the full training set (18,317 windows x 321 variables) exceeds the available compute; validation and test use all windows
ECL.batch_note: batch of 8 windows (8 x 321 = 2568 variable instances per step) for all arms: at the default 32 windows the base forecaster's per-variable FD encoder needs about 30 GB of activations, more than a 16 GB T4; validation/test are evaluated in batches of 8

comp.reused: none, raft_a1, raft_rt_a1, raft_noproj_a1 on the same settings and seeds from the Stage X ablation (identical code path)
comp.selection_rule: For rnc_cf and rnctf_cf separately: the weight with the lowest mean over the two settings of r = mean best-validation MSE / mean best-validation MSE of 'none' (same seeds); ties (|difference| < 1e-4): smaller weight. Test data are not used.
comp.tests: RAFT (raft_a1) against each competitor {selected rnc_cf, selected rnctf_cf, raft_pc_a1, raft_gs_a1, raft_noproj_a1 (plain sum), raft_rt_a1}: paired test-RMSE differences over the 10 (setting, seed) pairs; mean, 95% bootstrap CI, seeds better, exact two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test, Holm-adjusted over the competitors.

sens.reused: none, raft_a0.1, raft_a0.3, raft_a1 on the same seeds from the Stage X pilot
sens.tests: descriptive: validation ratio and test RMSE ratio against 'none' for alpha in {0.1, 0.3, 1, 3} and tau in {0.05, 0.1, 0.5}

probe.tests: descriptive: dispersion D_h and D_u, rank correlation rho between representation similarity and future similarity, KL(P || Q_h), on test windows (scripts/stage_x_raft.py representation_probe); two-dimensional embedding plot of the saved test representations of seed 42

ecl.controls: DLinear and RevIN-Linear with the same splits, look-back, scaling and training-window stride (CPU, same recipe as the Stage X controls)
ecl.tests: per setting: mean test RMSE over seeds, paired RMSE change of RAFT against TFB and against 'none', seeds better

cost.tests: descriptive: seconds per training epoch, peak GPU memory, trainable parameters, inference time on the test set; one run at a time on one GPU (no other run sharing it)

llm.tests: paired test-RMSE change of RAFT against TFB and against 'none' on E, seeds better (three pairs: descriptive, no significance test)

selection: only validation error selects anything; test evaluated once per run
